build_MarkerRelPosSensor: build a Habitat sensor that tracks the relative position of a marker to the robot end-effector
create_ArtJointSensor: create a sensor that gets the joint position and velocity of an articulated object in Habitat
create_ArtJointSensorNoVel: create a sensor that gets only the joint position of an articulated object without velocity
create_ArtObjReward: create a reward function for articulated object manipulation tasks with grasp penalties and distance rewards
create_EndEffectorDistToMarker: create a measure that computes the distance from the robot end-effector to a target marker
